body_markdown: The minimal round-2 handoff no longer needs an inherited minimum-degree core. Please return a rank-reaching certificate $(G,R,D)$ with $e(G)\ge a_\theta\epsilon$, $D\le K_\theta d$, and more than $D$ reached accepted points on every target line. AE-16 then performs global cleanup and degree-$D$ peeling.
